requirements.summary: Generate a QR code image that encodes the Friends AC Services website URL
acceptanceCriteria: A QR code image is generated that links to the website URL
The QR code is scannable and properly encodes the website address
The image has appropriate dimensions for clear scanning (minimum 300x300px recommended)

file_operations.description: Prepare Footer component to accept and display the generated QR code image that will be created at frontend/public/assets/generated/qr-code.dim_400x400.png

requirements.summary: Display the generated QR code in the Footer component alongside the existing contact information with appropriate styling and labeling
acceptanceCriteria: The QR code is visible in the Footer component
The QR code includes a descriptive label (e.g., 'Scan to visit our website')
The QR code styling is consistent with the existing warm accent color theme
The QR code is appropriately sized and positioned within the footer layout

file_operations.description: Add QR code display section to the Footer component. Reference the generated QR code image at frontend/public/assets/generated/qr-code.dim_400x400.png. Include a descriptive label 'Scan to visit our website' and ensure the QR code is styled consistently with the existing warm accent color theme. Position the QR code appropriately within the footer layout alongside existing contact information. The image should maintain appropriate sizing for clear scanning while fitting the footer design.

requirements.summary: Render the generated QR code image as a static asset in frontend/public/assets/generated directory for use in the Footer component
acceptanceCriteria: The QR code image file is saved in frontend/public/assets/generated
The image is referenced from the Footer component using the correct static asset path

file_operations.description: Ensure the Footer component correctly references the QR code image from the static asset path /assets/generated/qr-code.dim_400x400.png. Verify the image element uses appropriate alt text for accessibility and includes error handling for failed image loads.
